response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced and skilled senior developer with a strong background in web technologies, architecture, and mentorship. However, he is a poor fit for this role due to a critical lack of professional C++ experience, which is the primary language required. His resume shows only a brief, 7-month C++ project nearly a decade ago. Furthermore, he has no documented experience with the required Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) or IEC 62443 standards, which are core security competencies for this industrial automation position.
strengths: Extensive seniority (>15 years) and experience as a Staff/Senior engineer.
Demonstrated leadership and architectural skills through project founding, mentorship, and public speaking.
Strong background in high-performance, event-driven systems and microservices architecture.
concerns: Virtually no professional C++ experience; primary expertise is in web technologies (TypeScript, Node.js) and DLang.
No mention of required security expertise, specifically Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) or IEC 62443 standards.
Lacks experience in the industrial automation or manufacturing industry.
